scope_note: All district rows from four archived Science/IT stream-champion pages, with four separately captured item-completion pages. These are published stream-specific snapshots, not a whole-festival championship, signed final statement, entrant count or atomic database export.
transcription_note: HTML entities are decoded and display whitespace collapsed. Column labels, data-cell text, published order, champion/runnersup table headings and blank cells are retained. Blank numeric cells are null, never zero. Published order is not an independently inferred rank or tie-break. Exact raw bodies are identified by source hashes.
arithmetic_note: Complete-section comparisons are valid only when every section cell is numeric. A known-section sum can match Point despite a missing UP cell; that does not establish UP inclusion. Completion checks only compare displayed completed plus not-completed counts with the displayed item total.
finality_note: Item-completion and champion pages have different archive captures. Status does not certify the earlier table, settle appeals, establish subsequent revisions or prove final championship certification.
